pathway_3.name: Abyss
pathway_3.description:
A pathway focused on demonic powers, ritual magic, and corruption. Followers gain inhuman strength, the ability to cast dark spells,
summon devil projections, and manipulate the desires of others. They are feared as monsters who have lost their conscience.

physical_enhancement.name: Physical Enhancement
physical_enhancement.description: Criminals possess a strong body with keen instincts.

criminal_proficiency.name: Criminal Proficiency
criminal_proficiency.description: Mastery of all weapons - from swords to firearms to improvised tools.

brutal_strike.name: Brutal Strike
brutal_strike.description: A savage attack with any weapon or even bare hands.
brutal_strike.fight_description: You strike with brutal force, uncaring for your own safety.

dirty_fighting.name: Dirty Fighting
dirty_fighting.description: Fight without rules - kick, bite, or use underhanded tactics.
dirty_fighting.fight_description: You fight dirty, exploiting every weakness.

keen_instincts.name: Keen Instincts
keen_instincts.fight_description: Your instincts scream a warning as you anticipate the enemy's attack.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: Surrender to your violent desires for a surge of power.
bloodlust.fight_description: Bloodlust consumes you as you throw yourself at the enemy!

execute.name: Execute
execute.description: A devastating blow against weakened enemies.
execute.fight_description: You sense weakness and strike with lethal precision.

physical_enhancement.name: Demonic Physique
physical_enhancement.description: Your body becomes inhuman, twisted by demonic power.

demonic_strike.name: Demonic Strike
demonic_strike.description: Your attacks are infused with demonic energy.
demonic_strike.fight_description: Demonic energy courses through your weapon as you strike!

poison_flame.name: Poison Flame
poison_flame.description: Conjure sickly green flames that burn and poison.
poison_flame.fight_description: Toxic green flames erupt from your hands, searing the enemy!

language_of_foulness.name: Language of Foulness
language_of_foulness.description: Utter profane words that weaken your enemies.
language_of_foulness.fight_description: You speak words that should never be spoken, cursing your foe!

slowness.name: Slowness
slowness.description: Crush down with your palms to slow your target.
slowness.fight_description: You raise your arms and press down, making your enemy sink as though their wings were broken!

toxic_smoke.name: Toxic Smoke
toxic_smoke.description: Create a cloud of black toxic smoke.
toxic_smoke.fight_description: Thick black smoke billows forth, choking your enemies!

demonic_blessing.name: Demonic Blessing
demonic_blessing.description: Your demonic patron grants you protection.
demonic_blessing.fight_description: Demonic energy shields you from harm.

devil_spell.name: Devil Spell

physical_enhancement.name: Enhanced Demonic Body
physical_enhancement.description: Your demonic transformation continues, granting immense power.

devil_worship.name: Devil Worship Knowledge
devil_worship.description: You master ritualistic magic and devil summoning.

interference.name: Interference
interference.description: You can effectively interfere with divination and spirit channeling.

ritual_sacrifice.name: Ritual Sacrifice
ritual_sacrifice.description: Perform a dark ritual that drains life from enemies.
ritual_sacrifice.fight_description: Dark symbols appear in the air as you begin your sacrifice!

summon_devil_projection.name: Summon Devil Projection
summon_devil_projection.description: Summon a projection of a devil from the Abyss to fight for you.
summon_devil_projection.fight_description: A rift opens as a devil projection emerges to serve you!

corrupt_desires.name: Corrupt Desires
corrupt_desires.description: Twist your enemy's desires, turning them against themselves.
corrupt_desires.fight_description: You whisper into the enemy's soul, corrupting their very desires!

danger_intuition.name: Danger Intuition
danger_intuition.description: Your demonic senses warn you of incoming danger.
danger_intuition.fight_description: You sense the enemy's intent before they act!

demonic_growth.name: Demonic Growth
demonic_growth.description: Increase your size and power temporarily.
demonic_growth.fight_description: Dark energy courses through you as you grow in size and might!

abyss_resistance.name: Abyss Resistance
abyss_resistance.description: Your demonic nature resists mental attacks, poison, and curses.
abyss_resistance.fight_description: Dark energy shields your mind and body from harm.

serial_killing_spree.name: Serial Killing Spree
serial_killing_spree.description: Unleash a devastating combo of attacks fueled by bloodlust.
serial_killing_spree.fight_description: You lose yourself in the ecstasy of murder, striking again and again!

devil_favor.name: Devil's Favor
devil_favor.description: Call upon the favor you've earned from the Abyss.
devil_favor.fight_description: The Abyss answers your call, empowering your next attack!

abyss_gate.name: Abyss Gate
abyss_gate.description: Open a gate to the Abyss, dealing massive damage.
abyss_gate.fight_description: A gate to the Abyss opens, pulling your enemy toward damnation!
